name: Consommé
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 6, saucier 6

Flavor Profiles umami, bitter, salty, temperature, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients sweet or temperature

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 6
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Consommé is a clear soup made by mixing ground meats, carrots, celery, onion, tomatoes, and egg whites into a bouillon or stock, then simmering and stirring frequently to bring impurities to the surface. After filtering and/or skimming the soup for purity, it is finally ready.

When consumed, it grants a +6 enhancement two physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution) for the duration.

Additional sweet ingredients grant the bonus to two mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) for the duration instead.

Additional temperature ingredients grant the bonus to all three ability scores for the duration.
